headline: LeviLauncher 1.5.25
summary: This fork removes the Play Store install requirement so any installed Minecraft Bedrock Edition can be launched, and adds CI that builds and publishes releases without upstream secrets.

items.text: Removed the Play Store install check: the launcher no longer requires Minecraft to be installed from Google Play and works with any installed Minecraft Bedrock Edition.
Added GitHub Actions support for building and releasing APKs without the upstream Firebase or signing secrets.
Deleted the PlayStoreValidator and PlayStoreValidationDialog classes together with the unused invalid-license overlay and their translations.
Updated the README and documentation to describe the new Minecraft requirement.
